idea: MODSPLIT=1 freed the lines excluded only through a lane-hugging neighbour (E 174 St paid, 22 lines / 5,199 m -> 0), but it also split chains that were NOT modelled: a lane-hugging line inside such a chain used to lend its lift to the city polygons on it; split off, it became its own modelled chain, was excluded, and those polygons fell (all 5 modsplit-1 clusters: lost contact and (c)(ii) at line ends). MODSPLIT=2 splits only chains that are modelled today: their own-unmodelled lines are freed; chains that are not modelled stay joined. MODSPLIT=1 and off are unchanged.
question: Does MODSPLIT=2 keep modsplit-1's pay-back (E 174 St 0 m, deck gap down) without its lost contacts, (c)(ii) rise and LiDAR FAILs?
